description.value: Zamzam Grill is an authentic Middle Eastern counter-service restaurant on Vancouver's Kingsway corridor, specializing in freshly made shawarmas, falafel, and kababs using locally sourced, in-house marinated ingredients. The restaurant is halal-certified and accommodates vegetarian and vegan diners, making it a practical stop for cyclists with varied dietary needs. Its position on Kingsway, a major east-west arterial with bike infrastructure, places it on a natural cycling route through Vancouver.
